=== head internal/store/store.go
// Package store keeps values.
package store

import "errors"

// DefaultSize is the size of a new store.
const DefaultSize = 10

const (
	// ModeRead opens a store for reading.
	ModeRead Mode = iota
	ModeWrite
	modeInternal
)

var ErrMissing = errors.New("missing")

// Mode is how a store is opened.
type Mode int

// Store keeps values by key.
type Store struct {
	// Name is shown in logs.
	Name string // the display name
	secret int

	Size int
	mu   int
}

// New makes an empty store.
func New() *Store { return nil }

// Get returns the value of key, or fallback.
func (s *Store) Get(key string, fallback string) (string, bool) {
	return "", false
}

func (s *Store) Put(key, value string) {}

func (s *Store) lock() {}

type Reader interface {
	Read() error
	close()
}

func Open(path string) (*Store, error) { return nil, nil }

func Parse(s string) error { return nil }

func hidden() {}
